blockerFindings.title: The occupancy consumes the superseded g18-input-corpus.v1, states of it a property that is only true of v2, and attributes to it a leftover-join.v4 measurement that leftover-join.v4 made against v2 — while omitting v2 from basedOn and recordedInputs entirely
blockerFindings.location: basedOn.inputCorpusV1 (path, sha256, review, role) and recordedInputs
blockerFindings.finding:
The subject pins docs/coop/artifacts/g18-input-corpus.v1.json at dfc28bad… and describes it in basedOn.inputCorpusV1.role as: 'Named initial states from live G18 v2 exactByteIntent. fixtureBytes NOT-AUTHORED. leftover-join.v4 measured OBL-G18-INPUT-CORPUS leftoverDesign false. This occupancy consumes that naming.' Three of those four sentences do not hold of the artifact actually pinned.

First, the substance. g18-input-corpus.v2.json exists on disk at c86711910025acb979c5911e963b0ad18aa71af86d8293f8d7fcfa58b8716d96, mode 0444, and its own purpose field reads: 'Land the empty-state defect of g18-input-corpus.v1. Give each of the three live G18 v2 corpus classes named initial states drawn from that class's exactByteIntent, with NOT-AUTHORED markers attached to those named states rather than to the class name alone.' v1's initialStates array carries exactly three entries, and each entry carries only memberVerbatim (a re-quote of the harness-cell class name), fixtureBytes NOT-AUTHORED, and assertsNamedNotAuthored. It names zero initial states. v1's own whatIsAuthored says so in its own words: 'Three named initial states quoting live G18 v2 namedCorpusNotAuthored' — that is, quoting the class names. v2's entries by contrast each carry stateNamed (for example 'macos/arm64 digest-pinned crash injection at journal write') with a source field reading 'G18 v2 namedCorpusClasses[crash-injection].exactByteIntent', and v2's own accepted review records it as 'a naming of forty initial states over the three live G18 v2 corpus classes'. The subject's phrase 'Named initial states from live G18 v2 exactByteIntent' is therefore a description of v2. Of v1 it is false, and it is false in precisely the respect v2 was authored to repair.

Second, the attribution. The subject cites g18-leftover-join.v4 (D-193) as the current G18 leftover-join and rests OBL-G18-INPUT-CORPUS leftoverDesign false on it. leftover-join.v4's own bytes make that measurement against v2, not v1: obligations[OBL-G18-INPUT-CORPUS].reason opens 'g18-input-corpus.v2 names initial states from live G18 v2 namedCorpusClasses exactByteIntent (Claude ACCEPT 0/0; Codex not reviewed; CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED; binds NOTHING; fixtureBytes NOT-AUTHORED). leftover-design of unnamed G18 initial states is therefore stale as a naming claim.' leftover-join.v4's leftoverDesignOpenStanding says the same: 'leftover-design of unnamed G18 initial states is stale as a naming claim after g18-input-corpus.v2.' The measurement the subject invokes was made against bytes the subject does not pin.

Third, the custody set. leftover-join.v4's own recordedInputs pins four input-corpus files — v1 and its review, and v2 and its review — so that the version its measurement rests on is auditable from its own bytes. The subject pins two of those four, dropping exactly the pair carrying the measurement. g18-input-corpus.v2.json and g18-input-corpus.v2.review-independent.claude2.json occur nowhere in the subject: not in basedOn, not in recordedInputs, not in any path field. A reader auditing this occupancy from its own recordedInputs cannot reach the artifact that closed the obligation it claims is closed.
blockerFindings.failureScenario: A later D-000 recording pins this v3 as the current G18 occupancy and re-measures under the subject's own remeasurementClause, which requires re-measurement when a cited file moves. The clause quantifies over cited files, and g18-input-corpus.v2 is not cited. v2 can therefore move, be superseded, or have its accepted review withdrawn without tripping the clause, while the occupancy continues to assert OBL-G18-INPUT-CORPUS closed on a leftover-join.v4 measurement that rests on those very bytes. Meanwhile the occupancy's stated INPUT layer is v1, whose initialStates name no initial states at all — so the layer this occupancy declares it 'consumes' supplies nothing for the later fixture-authoring cycle to consume, and the forty named states that do exist are outside the pinned lineage. The defect is self-concealing in the direction that matters: the sentence describing v1 reads exactly like a correct description of the INPUT layer, so the gap would be trusted rather than checked, which is the same failure shape the v1 blocker CLAUDE-G18-V1-B1 was raised against.
blockerFindings.whyItMatters: This artifact's whole discipline is exact citation of the current lineage at live HEAD. Its authorityClaim, registerRowNote and remeasurementClause all turn on citing what is current and reciting it truthfully; its purpose field states the point twice. Every other citation in the file is exact — 22 of 22 digests match, seven live file-08 cells are byte-exact, both leftover-join leftoverDesign sets match, both predecessor recitals match to the digest. The one input that is stale is the one whose measurement the subject leans on, and the recital attached to it is not merely stale but affirmatively describes a property v1 does not have. Under the review prompt's own attack list this is the 'cited digests do not match' family: the digest resolves, but it resolves to the wrong artifact, and the claim made about that artifact is false.
blockerFindings.whatWouldRepairIt: Additive and local to basedOn plus recordedInputs. Pin g18-input-corpus.v2.json at c86711910025acb979c5911e963b0ad18aa71af86d8293f8d7fcfa58b8716d96 and g18-input-corpus.v2.review-independent.claude2.json at 63fcbfae1e6d33268522de680f964d8893494222060df20aef2ec478fab952e4, as leftover-join.v4 itself pins them. Attach the leftover-join.v4 OBL-G18-INPUT-CORPUS sentence to v2, where leftover-join.v4 put it. Retain v1 as the frozen predecessor with its role corrected to what v1 is — three classes re-quoted from namedCorpusNotAuthored, zero initial states, empty-state defect landed at v2 — and route 'This occupancy consumes that naming' to v2. Nothing else in the artifact moves; the live-cell decomposition, the three corpus classes, EV-1..EV-5, the splits, the file-08 quotations and the HEAD triple all stand as written.

decision.rule: ACCEPT only at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX.
decision.scopeOfReject: REJECT of harness.DR-G18.lifecycle-generation-recovery.v3 at 1 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX. The rejection is narrow and repairable: it lands on basedOn.inputCorpusV1 and recordedInputs only. The occupancy's substantive body — the seven byte-exact file-08 quotations, the five-member live-cell decomposition, the three named corpus classes, EV-1 through EV-5, the twenty-one authority splits, the HEAD triple, the 22 matching digests, and the landed repair of CLAUDE-G18-V1-B1 — survived every attack run against it.
decision.summaryForCoordinator: REJECT at 1 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX. Subject custody verified: sha256 fe9815a4… as expected, mode 0444, unmoved. All 22 recordedInputs digests resolve byte-exactly and recordedInputs.HEAD equals live HEAD 443d951. All seven live DR-G18 file-08 cells are quoted byte-exact, including the harness cell. required-now 28, condition 2 at 4/32, condition 5 NOT MET, D-215 last heading, file 08 carries G18 — all confirmed against live bytes. Both leftover-join leftoverDesign sets match: [OBL-G18-FX-AUTHORING] on G18, [OBL-G18-FX-AUTHORING, OBL-ENCODING-RESERVED] on DR-107. Nothing is SATISFIED, no journal or fixture bytes are invented, OBL-ENCODING-RESERVED is not stolen, v1 and v2 stay frozen and non-current, and docs/v2/implementation/ is not authorized. CLAUDE-G18-V1-B1 is landed at EV-5. The single blocker CLAUDE-G18-V3-B1 is a citation defect: the subject pins the superseded g18-input-corpus.v1, describes it with a property only v2 has ('named initial states from live G18 v2 exactByteIntent' — v1 names zero initial states, which is the empty-state defect v2 was authored to land), and attributes to it the OBL-G18-INPUT-CORPUS closure that g18-leftover-join.v4 measured against v2, while omitting v2 and its accepted review from basedOn and recordedInputs entirely. leftover-join.v4 pins all four input-corpus files; the subject pins two, dropping the pair that carries the measurement it invokes. Repair is additive and confined to basedOn plus recordedInputs; no other field moves.
decision.independence: Reached without reading the Codex review or any other reviewer's output on this subject. Every claim in this verdict was measured from live bytes on disk at HEAD 443d951.
